evidence.observation: Pressure steady near 3.05 Torr through ramp and early growth (3.066 at 2640 s)
Pressure rose steadily 3.138→3.193→3.302→3.377 Torr from 2760 to 3120 s
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm setpoint, so the rise is not caused by the flow input
Thermocouple at 750.0 °C setpoint, heater power ~44%, both stable
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere can't be verified and leak vs blockage can't be told apart

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test (isolate the Ar supply and watch pressure), or checking the exhaust line/valve for a restriction, would show whether this is a seal leak or an exhaust blockage.
